scope: Seeded paused CargoShip rendering on one host; no general gameplay FPS or pixel-equivalence claim

separateSequences: com_maxfps 0 after view 180; web 125 Hz safety ceiling remains

notes: The historical 26.027 ms mean was not used as the final control: fresh controls and the same timing method are required.

A legacy callback control completed at 21.145 ms; two candidate attempts failed that method because system events suppress most sub-16 ms callbacks. All versions were rerun with canonical checkpoints.
Dirty flags in a few production records reflect benchmark-harness edits only. The selected Wasm artifacts were retained unchanged and hash-checked by the runner.
Diagnostic timing is supporting stage evidence from separate runs; host drift prevents attributing its entire CPU-time difference to code.
Recovery uses the existing explicit loss/restore handlers and checks rebuilt resources plus resumed draw work; no real driver reset was injected.
